hook: A $20 set that ends the dirty-spatula scramble mid-turkey.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide shot of a stove with four burners active and an oven door glowing from a turkey inside, one spatula being rinsed frantically in the sink.
scenes.voiceover: Nobody tells you the second Thanksgiving bottleneck isn't chopping — it's not having a clean spatula.

scenes.visual_prompt: The Umite Chef 33-piece utensil set fully laid out in its stand on a clean counter, labeled price card '$19.99' beside it.
scenes.voiceover: This set is $19.99 for 33 pieces — tongs, basting brush, spatulas, whisk, ladles — backed by 30,314 ratings.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of a silicone spatula sliding across a hot non-stick pan with no melting, no scratching, steam rising.
scenes.voiceover: Reviewers say the silicone heads hold up at high heat without melting or scratching non-stick pans.

scenes.visual_prompt: The organized utensil stand on a tidy counter cut against an earlier clip of the chaotic half-chopped cutting board.
scenes.voiceover: With this many pieces, you're not washing one spatula just to reuse it for the next dish.

scenes.visual_prompt: Simple price comparison graphic: '$19.99 for 33 pieces' versus an icon of a cluttered mismatched utensil drawer with a strike-through.
scenes.on_screen_text: Priced to replace the whole drawer.
scenes.voiceover: At under $20 for all of this, it's cheaper than replacing your mismatched drawer one piece at a time.

scenes.visual_prompt: Closing card showing five compared product thumbnails in a row with a blog icon and 'link in bio' text.
scenes.on_screen_text: 4 more tools compared → link in bio.
scenes.voiceover: This is one of five under-$25 tools I checked against actual Thanksgiving prep — rest is on the blog.

caption: The chopper fixes your cutting board. This $19.99 set fixes the second mess — four burners going, oven full, and one spatula doing everything. 33 pieces, 30,314 ratings, priced to replace your whole mismatched drawer. Full comparison on the blog (link in bio).
